_doc: Data for test/unit/external_law_registry_tripwire.test.ts — the NAMED exemptions of the external-value law registry and the outcome pins of the nodes the 2026-10-30 catalog-term bug is about, over the two judged corpora (src/core/test_data/test_tld_ontology.json + the shipped install/import/ontology/<release> packages). Kept here, not in the gate, because it names install-TLD tipos the shipped packages carry (fixtures/ is data, outside the generic_tld census). SHRINK-ONLY: an entry whose node stops matching it (now a law, no longer carrying the edge, gone) is red until removed; a new refusal is red until it is either fixed in the ontology or named here with a reason.
